note.en: Phase sequence (6 milestones). Install original window trim over HardieBoard before wall tile; verify toilet flange before Warm Gray floor grouting.
note.es: Secuencia por etapas (6 hitos). Instalar moldura original de ventana sobre HardieBoard antes del azulejo de muro; verificar brida antes de emboquillar piso.

steps.en: Demolition, plumbing rough-in, exhaust fan duct, Kohler K-1821 tub set & leak-tested, and Schluter floor waterproofing complete
steps.es: Demolición, plomería en bruto, ducto de extractor, tina Kohler K-1821 instalada y probada e impermeabilizante Schluter listos

steps.en: Calacatta Gem 12×24 matte floor tile laid (ungrouted) and shower HardieBoard backer + soap niches installed
steps.es: Piso Calacatta Gem 12×24 mate colocado (sin boquilla) y HardieBoard de regadera con nichos instalado

steps.en: Install original window trim over HardieBoard (before wall tile) & set 20A GFCI rough-in boxes
steps.es: Instalar moldura original de ventana sobre HardieBoard (antes del azulejo de muro) y cajas GFCI de 20A

steps.en: Verify toilet flange, grout floor with Warm Gray grout, and complete white 3×6 wall tile, niches & tub surround
steps.es: Verificar brida de inodoro, emboquillar piso con Warm Gray y terminar azulejo blanco 3×6 en muros y nichos

steps.en: Complete attic ceiling electrical junction, close bathroom ceiling, prime/paint & hang outward-swing door
steps.es: Completar conexión eléctrica en ático, cerrar techo del baño, fondear/pintar y colocar puerta abatible

steps.en: Install pedestal sink, 10" rough-in toilet, Champagne Bronze trim/faucets, glass screen, medicine cabinet & lights
steps.es: Instalar lavabo de pedestal, inodoro de 10", llaves Champagne Bronze, cancel de vidrio, botiquín e iluminación
